# DuBois

> https://race.heterodata.org

Race, stratification and economic disparities in the United States across six measurable dimensions — wealth, income, employment, poverty, housing, and criminal justice — reconstructed from authoritative public sources.

Generated from ecosystem.json (kit v2.0).

## Resources

- Data: https://race.heterodata.org/data — formats: csv; kind: page
  - Data dictionary: https://race.heterodata.org/data/files/data_dictionary.csv
- Code: https://github.com/andenick/race-web — languages: python; license: MIT; kind: repo
- Outputs: https://race.heterodata.org/explore — Explore the series
